data.title: You are in the right place. We believe in humans
paragraphs: Content Basis has joined Content Cucumber. The technology Content Basis built now sits behind a larger team of writers, and the writing itself is still done by people.
Your account, your data, and the person you have been working with come with you. Nothing about how you file a request changes.

items.label: What changes
items.value: The team behind your account gets bigger. You get access to writers, editors, and strategists who were not available under Content Basis alone.

items.label: What does not change
items.value: Your account, your data, your rates, and the way you request work. Humans still write everything that goes out under your name.

items.label: Who to talk to
items.value: The same people. If you are unsure who owns your account now, send us a note and we will point you at them.

items.label: What to do next
items.value: Nothing, unless you want something. The work continues on the same cadence it was already on.

data.title: Why we made this move
data.subtitle: Two companies that were solving the same problem from opposite ends.

items.title: Human-first content
items.text: Every piece is written by somebody who understands nuance, context, and how your brand sounds. Models assist the research and the checking, and people do the writing.

items.title: Technology that gets out of the way
items.text: Content Basis built tools for HubSpot, analytics, and content management. Those tools now make the writers faster instead of standing in for them.

items.title: A transition you do not have to manage
items.text: Accounts, data, and relationships transfer without you filling anything in. If something does not carry over cleanly, that is ours to fix and not yours to chase.

items.title: A bigger bench
items.text: Writers, editors, designers, and strategists on one team, so the work you used to send elsewhere can come here instead.

data.title: Why we made this move
data.lede: I founded Content Basis on the same belief I hold now, which is that people matter and the writing is the part you cannot hand to a machine.

paragraphs: Content Basis had the technology and Content Cucumber had the writers, and putting the two together made more sense than either of us building the other half from scratch.

The content industry is at a crossroads. A lot of agencies are replacing writers with models to cut costs, and we are going the other way, using models to make a human team more effective rather than to stand in for one. Your customers can tell the difference, and your brand deserves a voice that belongs to somebody.
That is a statement about the future we want, one where technology amplifies what people can do instead of removing them from it. Welcome to Content Cucumber.
Brent Peterson, Founder of Content Basis and CEO of Content Cucumber.
